title: Boeing's Biggest 737 Max Jet Gets Approved to Fly Passengers
summary:
On Tuesday, the Federal Aviation Administration, or FAA, said Boeing's 737 Max 10 jet can carry passengers. The FAA is the U.S. agency that keeps air travel safe. Boeing first showed the plane in 2017, so the approval took nearly ten years.

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy shared the news at Boeing's factory in Everett, Washington. He said the plane went through thousands of hours of test flights and safety checks.

The Max 10 is the biggest plane in its family. It can carry about 185 to 210 people. That could mean more seats on busy routes.

Boeing has had safety problems in the past, including two crashes of a smaller Max 8 plane in 2018 and 2019. Those led the FAA to check Boeing's planes more closely.

More than 30 customers have ordered 1,555 Max 10 jets. Boeing plans to start delivering them in 2027. Each jet must still be checked before it carries passengers.
